title: wringer.nextmove.v1
description:
THE NEXT MOVE, NEVER A VERDICT. What a person does after a worker's turn produced nothing — one sentence ending in the command that continues — composed by `diagnose.WorkerDiagnosis.next_move` from the turn's FACTS and written beside the facts it was composed from, so a reader can check the sentence against them. Nothing that reads this file may let it reach a verdict: not acceptance's receipts, not vacuity, not health. The same boundary `worker-diagnosis-v3.schema.json` carries, for the same reason.

WHY IT EXISTS. Run 4B, 2026-09-01: a shell worker exited 1 on a dead key, the response carried `401 invalid_api_key`, the pre-spend line had already said which credential the turn would spend against and that it displaced a working stored login — and the operator read "an attempt changed nothing at all". Two facts, each shown, joined by nobody. The join is one sentence: which credential this turn spent against, what to do about it, and the command that continues. A stop without a next move is a stop the product has not finished writing.

A SIBLING file in the loop bundle, beside `worker-diagnosis.json`, because `wringer.workerdiagnosis.v3` is published, frozen and `additionalProperties: false` (law 7: a byte change without a new schema_version is a silent break for every reader; a new file is always allowed). Written only when a worker diagnosis was, so ABSENT means the last turn did something — the same rule as its sibling — and `wring explain <loop directory>` quotes `next_move` from here after the terminal is gone.

COMPOSED FROM FACTS ONLY. `face` × `lane` × `auth_state` × the typed credential facts. The worker's own words are never read to compose it — F6: route on facts, hint on text, claim on neither — and a shape no sentence honestly fits records the literal `no next move is known for this shape`: an honest blank, never silence.

next_move.description: The one thing to do next, ending in the command that continues — the literal `wringer-drive resume` — or the exact honest blank `no next move is known for this shape`. Composed once, by `diagnose.WorkerDiagnosis.next_move`; the console, `wring run --json`, `wringer-drive` and `wring explain` all QUOTE this sentence and none composes a second.

face.description: Which shape the worker's turn wore — the same closed enum as `worker-diagnosis-v3.schema.json`, derived from `diagnose.WORKER_FACES`, and equal to the sibling record's `face`.

lane.description: Which worker form's facts composed the sentence. `acp`: the ACP session lane, whose ledger is the `worker-diagnosis.json` record's. `shell`: the shell / `exec:` lane of the 0.6.0 worker contract, whose whole testimony is its exit code and output. Recorded here because the sibling record cannot carry it (frozen), and a reader telling the lanes apart by which fields are present is guessing.

auth_state.description: What the agent's own auth surface said when the stop was composed — the same value as the sibling record's `auth_state`, present only when the agent was asked. An OPEN string on the `wringer.loop.v2` `reason` precedent; known values are `logged_in`, `logged_out`, `unknown` and `not_applicable`.

key_env.description: The NAME of the vendor's key variable, present only when it was SET in the environment the turn inherited — by the measured precedence (run 3 F7, ACP 2026-08-27) it is then the credential the turn spent against. A variable name from `agents.SHELL_VENDORS`, never a value; the bundle's redactor scrubs the file on the way to disk like every other write. Absent when no key was set, or when nobody asked.

login_stored.description: What the vendor's own login probe said about the STORED login at the stop — true, false — present only when it was asked. With `key_env` present and this true, the sentence is run 4B's: the key is overriding a stored login that reports itself valid, and the move is to unset it.

exit_code.description: The shell lane's exit code for a failed turn, the loop's own fact. Present only for the shell lane's `turn_refused`.
